error_shape.note: delta = estimated sharps minus notated sharps; negative means the reading has MORE flats than the score. A correction rule keyed on the correlation gap was measured and rejected -- see transcriber/config.py.

ornaments.note: synthetic = one voice and one symbol, which isolates the detector; real = notated trills in real repertoire, which is the honest figure. They disagree sharply and both are kept.

mordent.label: all
mordent.invalid_reason: no reference symbols and none detected

turn.label: all
turn.invalid_reason: no reference symbols and none detected

staccato.note: performance is SYNTHESISED -- notated staccato rendered at 30% of written value, everything else at 95% -- because notation says whether a note is staccato while the detector asks whether one was played short. An upper bound: it shows the detector recovers a clean signal, not that it survives a real pianist. Only the first 600 notes of each score are scored, for runtime.

dynamics.reason: every available source is constant-velocity; see notation.analysis.has_dynamics

meter.reason: no meter detector exists -- the time signature is a CLI argument, so scoring it would measure the input

conclusion: On TONAL repertoire, key signature accuracy is 0.800 over 40 scores, tonic accuracy 0.675 over the 40 scores whose ground truth names a tonic. Signature is the figure that matters for engraving: it decides every accidental on the page, and a reading can get it right while naming the relative major or minor as the tonic. On MODAL repertoire (Palestrina, Monteverdi, trecento) it is 0.575 over 40 scores. That gap is expected rather than a defect: Krumhansl-Schmuckler models tonal key, and these scores predate it. The two are reported separately because Palestrina alone is 71% of the music21 corpus, so a pooled figure would describe repertoire this project does not target. On SYNTHETIC ornaments -- one voice, one symbol -- trill precision is 1.000 and recall 0.667 (tp=12 fn=6). Every miss is the same case: a trill notated on a sixteenth or shorter realises to 2 notes, below TRILL_MIN_ALTERNATIONS = 4. Realisation subdivides the written value, so the run length goes 2, 4, 8, 16 -- never 3 -- which is why lowering that constant to 3 recovers NOTHING while admitting mordents, which realise to exactly 3 adjacent-pitch notes. Measured: MIN=3 leaves recall unchanged and turns 0 false trills into 48. On REAL repertoire the same detector reads precision 0.446 and recall 0.270 (tp=33 fp=41 fn=89). That is the honest figure and it is far below the synthetic one: real trills sit inside polyphony, where other voices interleave with the alternation and break the run. The synthetic case localises a failure; this one sizes it. Treat the exact value as roughly +/-0.05 rather than a precise reading -- the detector is rate-based, so the assumed tempo moves it: swept over 60-140 BPM, F1 ranges 0.337-0.446 with no monotonic trend, because the notated scores carry no tempo of their own and one has to be assumed. Mordents and turns produced 0 false trill detections: the conservative bias in notation/analysis.py holds, and the detector does not invent symbols it was not given. Ornament ground truth is synthesised, not corpus-derived. The sampled scores do contain {'trill': 146, 'mordent': 24} notated ornaments, but they are concentrated in 7 of 80 scores -- one Beethoven quartet movement alone carries 67 trills. What an F1 needs is INDEPENDENT examples, and a handful of scores cannot supply them however many symbols each one repeats. Scoring against the corpus would measure a few pieces, not the detector. Staccato scores precision 0.974 and recall 0.873 (F1 0.920, tp=1116 fp=30 fn=163) -- the strongest detector here, and it returned 0 of 937 notes before Phase 21 fixed the denominator it compared against. The performance is synthesised, so read it as an upper bound on a clean signal rather than a claim about real playing. The reported confidence is weakly calibrated: median correlation 0.924 when the signature is right against 0.893 when it is wrong. It separates, but not by enough to use as a threshold -- its real value is at the extremes, where it correctly declined ['drum_sample', 'webern_dormi_jesu_op_16_no_2']. Dynamics are not scored. Every corpus and MIDI source available here is constant-velocity or near it, so a dynamics accuracy would report the mapping's opinion of a constant rather than a reading -- the same degeneracy velocity_valid guards in evaluation/metrics.py.
